# Workshop question ids

*Generated by `scripts/question_registry.py` — do not edit by hand.*

The workshop database stores each answer as (group, question id, value): the id is
the only link between a stored number and the question that was asked. A group
also stores the theme it played (`ws_groups.topic`). This page lists every id that
can hold answers, so that any row of `ws_answers` / `ws_answer_log` can be read.

- A question answered with several sliders stores the combined figure under its
  own id and each slider under `<id>__<part>`.
- Ids are never reused: a question whose unit or meaning changes gets a new id, and
  the old one stays here (D62, D69).
- ★ marks the active line-up (`workshop-2026-11`). A question played in no line-up is
  *archived*: still defined and worded, shown by the reveal for the sittings that
  answered it.

## Themes made of other themes' questions (D70)

Their groups are stored under their own topic id; the questions keep their
ids, so the same question id can hold answers under several topics.

| topic | file | includes |
|---|---|---|
| `buildings-heat` | `buildings-heat.yaml` | `residential-heat`, `tertiary-heat` |

## Retired ids (no longer defined anywhere)

Answers stored under these ids belong to questions removed before line-ups
existed. `git show <commit>:website/data/levers_<sector>.js` gives the full
definition, `git show <commit>:website/workshop/content/<topic>.yaml` the wording.

| id | topic | unit answered in | last defined in | replaced by | why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `truck-load` | `inland-mobility` | tonnes (average payload per vehicle-km, empty runs included) | `aa62082` | `truck-fill` | a payload in tonnes became a filling rate in %, D62 |
| `car-energy__speed` | `inland-mobility` | % less energy per km (speed slider of car-energy) | `b21345c` | `car-energy__speed-kmh` | the slider now speaks km/h less on average, D64 |
| `car-energy__size` | `inland-mobility` | % less energy per km (size slider of car-energy) | `b21345c` | `car-energy__mass` | the slider now speaks an average car mass in kg, D64 |
| `long-haul-fuel` | `international-mobility` | kWh per long-haul aircraft-km | `1f10348` | `plane-fuel` | merged with short-haul-fuel into the fleet average, D45 |
| `short-haul-fuel` | `international-mobility` | kWh per short-haul aircraft-km | `1f10348` | `plane-fuel` | merged with long-haul-fuel into the fleet average, D45 |
| `insulation` | `residential-heat` | kWh/m²/year of heating need | `e4f58a4` | `renovation-rate`, `renovation-depth` | split into the rate and the depth of renovation, D51 |
